items.source_en:
CHAPTER I

TREATISE ON THE SOCIAL STRUCTURE AND ARCHITECTURE OF THE TARIS UPPER CITY

Among the vast urban sprawl of Taris, the Upper City rises as a testament to prosperity and privilege. Towering skyscrapers and meticulously maintained streets define this district, reserved for the wealthiest and most influential citizens of the planet. It is a world of glittering cantinas, bustling marketplaces, and corporate offices that hum with the ceaseless rhythm of galactic commerce.

Shielded from the chaos of the Lower City by strict security and social stratification, the Upper City embodies a facade of order and progress. Yet, beneath its shining exterior lies the uneasy tension of a society divided—a contrast that would one day mark the planet's tragic downfall.

[The chapters that follow delve into the cultural and architectural marvels of the Upper City, exploring the lives of its inhabitants and the shadows cast by the looming unrest below.]

제1장

타리스 상부 도시의 사회 구조와 건축 양식에 관한 소론

타리스에 아득하게 뻗어 나간 거대한 도시권 한가운데서, 상부 도시는 번영과 특권의 상징으로서 위풍당당하게 솟아 있습니다. 하늘을 찌를 듯한 마천루와 세심하게 관리된 깨끗한 거리가 이 구역을 대변하며, 이곳은 행성에서 가장 부유하고 영향력 있는 극소수 상류층 시민들의 전유물입니다. 빛나는 칸티나, 활기찬 시장, 그리고 은하계 상업의 끊임없는 리듬에 맞춰 윙윙거리는 기업 사무실들이 가득한 그들만의 세상인 셈입니다.

삼엄한 치안과 견고한 사회적 계급 격차 덕분에 하부 도시의 혼란으로부터 완전히 격리된 상부 도시는 질서와 진보라는 겉치레를 아주 보기 좋게 유지하고 있습니다. 그러나 이 눈부신 표면 아래에는 분열된 사회가 품은 기분 나쁜 긴장감이 팽배해 있으며, 이러한 극단적인 대비는 머지않아 이 행성에 임할 참혹한 몰락의 불씨가 되었습니다.

[이어지는 장에서는 상부 도시의 문화적, 건축적 경이로움을 깊이 파고들며, 그곳에 살아가는 주민들의 삶과 하부 도시에서 엄습해 오는 어두운 불안의 그림자를 상세히 파헤칩니다.]

items.source_en:
Unanswered questions:
1) Who created the Facility?
2) Is the Mission the real reason it was created?
3) Do we really share the DNA of our namesakes?
4) Are any people watching us?
5) Are the droids as unintelligent as they appear?
6) Are the "reborn" really what they claim?
7) So many more questions.

So few people are asking the right questions.

From: Siún Nagle
Subject: We have to resist!!!

locations.vanilla_source_en:
Great Serpent, is this a test of my faith? Do you truly wish to plumb the depths of my loyalty? What other explanation could merit why you would permit such a spectacular disaster?

Dinner at Deputy Roland's was initially promising. Even congenial. Yes, there were pointed questions about House Va'ruun's intentions, but overall an air of polite decorum was maintained. 

But it was when one of Roland's more boisterous guests - an officer of some type, perhaps having enjoyed one too many glasses of Chandra - asked, "But how can we trust you snakes after what you did?" that I believed the Gravid reached her breaking point. They were only words, but words are the battlefield on which diplomacy is fought. And I realized too late that this was a salvo Si'ah would not let pass.

As dessert was served, Si'ah excused herself. We waited for her return. And waited. And waited. When it had become clear the Gravid had simply left, I made my pleasantries and rushed back to the embassy. There, I found her packing her things. When I asked where she was going, she stated simply "I have seen all I need to."

And she left without another word.

I've reached out to my contacts back in Dazra, who have assured me that they still believe in the venture. That Jarek Va'ruun himself still believes. And that is all the reassurance I require.
